pois.label: VOx 微测辐射热计焦平面
pois.detail: 640×512、12 µm 像元的氧化钒微测辐射热计阵列——每个像元是一片悬空 SiN/VOx 薄膜,只靠两条 0.35 µm 宽、30 µm 长的折叠桥腿与基底相连。红外功率落在膜上→温度微升→VOx 电阻变化(TCR -2.3%/K)→逐行脉冲偏置读出。桥腿是全设计的核心账:腿越细长 G 越小越灵敏,但 τ=C/G 越慢、工艺越脆。
pois.detail_en: A 640×512, 12 µm-pitch vanadium-oxide microbolometer array. Each pixel is a suspended SiN/VOx membrane held by just two folded legs 0.35 µm wide and 30 µm long. Incident IR power warms the membrane, VOx resistance shifts (TCR -2.3 %/K), and a pulsed row bias reads it out. The legs are the core trade of the whole design: thinner and longer means lower G and better sensitivity, but slower τ=C/G and a more fragile process.
sim: NETD 预算(mars-ir/out/01):Johnson 27.8 + 相位子 31.0 + 1/f 15.0 + ROIC 16.9 → RSS 47.3 mK,达标 <60 mK
桥腿 trade 扫描:可行域(NETD<60 ∧ τ<12ms)仅在 w≤0.5 µm 打开;w=0.3/L=40 可到 32 mK 但 τ=11.4 ms 贴 30 Hz 红线
FD 交叉验证:1D 桥腿+集总膜瞬态 τ=8.43 ms vs 解析 7.67 ms(+9.9%,桥腿分布热容效应,符号符合预期)
COMSOL 3D 热 FEM 交叉验证(out/06,无头 6.3):稳态 G_fem=1.030e-8 W/K 对解析 -1.0%;瞬态 63.2% 上升 τ=9.45 ms——集总 7.67→1D FD 8.43→3D FEM 9.45 ms 单调链=分布腿热容+多模响应,30 Hz 判据 τ<12 ms 仍闭合(裕度 36%→21%)

吸收腔 TMM 账(out/07):λ/4 谐振腔(SiN/VOx/NiCr 377 Ω·sq⁻¹/2.5 µm 真空腔/Al 镜)dM/dT 加权带平均 η=0.868 正入射、f/1 锥内 0.883;R_s 200–700 Ω·sq⁻¹ 与腔厚 2.2–2.8 µm 全域 η 落在 0.80–0.90 → 01 账假设的 0.80 是**下界**,NETD 47.3 mK 是保守值,实际 42–47 mK
电热耦合账(out/08):恒压偏置下 dP/dT=|α|P,临界 P_crit=G/|α|=0.45 µW,而读出脉冲 20 µW 超判据 44×——靠 0.195% 占空压住(帧平均裕度 11.6×);脉冲自热正反馈把线性估计 16.3 K 推到 20.4 K,发散时间 173 µs 对 65 µs 行时仅 2.7× 裕度
Sentaurus TCAD 交叉验证(out/09):P-2019.03 TMM 无头重算同一叠层,R(λ) 25 点全带与解析 TMM 一致到 0.001% 相对偏差;Sentaurus A_Total 比 η_abs 高的 0.0161 恰等于铝镜欧姆吸收(定义差,非分歧)
sim_en: NETD budget (mars-ir/out/01): Johnson 27.8 + phonon 31.0 + 1/f 15.0 + ROIC 16.9 → 47.3 mK RSS, meets <60 mK
Leg trade sweep: feasible region (NETD<60 ∧ τ<12 ms) opens only at w≤0.5 µm; w=0.3/L=40 reaches 32 mK but τ=11.4 ms rides the 30 Hz limit
FD cross-check: 1-D leg + lumped membrane transient gives τ=8.43 ms vs 7.67 ms analytic (+9.9%, distributed leg heat capacity, expected sign)

COMSOL 3-D thermal FEM cross-check (out/06, headless 6.3): stationary G_fem=1.030e-8 W/K, −1.0% vs analytic; transient 63.2%-rise τ=9.45 ms — monotone chain lumped 7.67 → 1-D FD 8.43 → 3-D FEM 9.45 ms from distributed leg capacity and multi-mode response; the 30 Hz criterion τ<12 ms still closes (margin 36%→21%)

Absorber-cavity TMM (out/07): the λ/4 resonant stack (SiN / VOx / NiCr 377 Ω·sq⁻¹ / 2.5 µm vacuum gap / Al mirror) gives a dM/dT-weighted band average η=0.868 at normal incidence and 0.883 over the f/1 cone; across R_s 200–700 Ω·sq⁻¹ and gaps 2.2–2.8 µm η stays in 0.80–0.90, so ledger 01's assumed 0.80 is a **lower bound** and NETD 47.3 mK is conservative (realistic 42–47 mK)

Electrothermal account (out/08): under constant-voltage bias dP/dT=|α|P, critical power P_crit=G/|α|=0.45 µW while the read pulse is 20 µW — 44× over the runaway criterion, held only by the 0.195% duty cycle (frame-average margin 11.6×); positive feedback lifts the linear 16.3 K pulse self-heating to 20.4 K, and the 173 µs divergence time leaves just 2.7× margin on the 65 µs row time

Sentaurus TCAD cross-check (out/09): P-2019.03 TMM re-ran the same stack headless; R(λ) matches the analytic TMM to 0.001% relative over 25 wavelengths. Sentaurus A_Total exceeds η_abs by 0.0161, exactly the aluminium mirror's ohmic absorption — a definition difference, not a disagreement
physics: 测辐射热计三步:吸收(λ/4 谐振腔 η≈0.8)→ 升温 dT=P/G → 电阻读出 dV=αVb·dT;responsivity ∝ 1/G,这就是把 G 压到 1e-8 W/K 的理由
相位子噪声 = 温度涨落 kT²/C 的统计极限——不是工程缺陷,是悬空小热容的热力学代价
physics_en: Bolometer in three steps: absorb (λ/4 cavity, η≈0.8) → warm by dT=P/G → read dV=αVb·dT; responsivity ∝ 1/G — that is why G is pushed to 1e-8 W/K
Phonon noise = the kT²/C temperature-fluctuation limit — not an engineering defect but the thermodynamic price of a tiny suspended heat capacity

pois.label: 锗物镜 f/1(黑镜头)
pois.detail: 锗双片 f/1 物镜,焦距 14 mm,前表面镀类金刚石(DLC)硬膜抗尘蚀。镜头在可见光下是纯黑的——锗带隙 0.66 eV,吸收一切可见光,却在 2–16 µm 高透。可见光玻璃(BK7/熔石英)在 8–14 µm 因多声子吸收完全不透,所以热像仪没有第二种选择。遮光罩挡直射日光与溅尘,竖直窗口把积尘速率压到水平面的十分之一。
pois.detail_en: A germanium doublet at f/1, 14 mm focal length, front surface hardened with a DLC coating against dust abrasion. The lens is pure black to the eye — germanium's 0.66 eV bandgap absorbs all visible light, yet it transmits 2–16 µm. Visible-light glasses (BK7, fused silica) are fully opaque across 8–14 µm due to multiphonon absorption, so a thermal camera has no second choice. The hood blocks direct sun and dust splash; the vertical window cuts dust deposition to a tenth of the horizontal rate.

specs.衍射: Airy 24.4 µm ≈ 2 像元, Q=0.83 探测器受限

sim: 足印账(mars-ir/out/02):100 m 处 8.6 cm/像元、400 m 处 34 cm——高地站址覆盖城核心区资产
MTF@Nyquist 41.7 lp/mm = 衍射 0.49 × 像元 0.64 = 0.31
尘账(out/04):竖窗+罩 0.028%/sol → 200 sol 遮挡 5.4%,表观偏差 -1.4 K 慢漂移,场景 NUC 连续吸收;每 ~100 sol 对已知目标绝对重标
sim_en: Footprint ledger (mars-ir/out/02): 8.6 cm/pixel at 100 m, 34 cm at 400 m — the highland site covers the city core
MTF@Nyquist 41.7 lp/mm = diffraction 0.49 × detector 0.64 = 0.31
Dust ledger (out/04): vertical window + hood 0.028 %/sol → 5.4 % obscuration at 200 sol, -1.4 K apparent bias as slow drift absorbed by scene NUC; absolute re-cal vs known targets every ~100 sol
physics: 锗 n=4.0:单面菲涅耳反射 36%,不镀膜双面只剩 47% 透过——AR 膜不是锦上添花是生死线
LWIR 里锗色散极低(等效阿贝数 ~1000),单材双片即校好色差;dn/dT=396e-6/K 是它唯一的软肋,靠罩+保温+TEC 舱温压住
physics_en: Ge n=4.0: 36 % Fresnel loss per surface, only 47 % through uncoated — AR coating is life-or-death, not polish
Ge dispersion in LWIR is tiny (effective Abbe ~1000), so a single-material doublet corrects color; dn/dT=396e-6/K is its one weakness, held down by hood, insulation and the TEC-warmed enclosure

pois.label: TEC 稳温与散热鳍
pois.detail: 机头尾部的黑色鳍阵是单级热电堆(TEC)的热端。微测辐射热计不需要制冷——只需要稳温:FPA 钉在 288 K ±10 mK,让电阻工作点不漂。这正是选它而不选碲镉汞(MCT)光子探测器的理由:MCT 要 77 K 深冷,斯特林制冷机是运动件,而这座塔上没有任何一件会磨损的东西。
pois.detail_en: The black fin array at the rear is the hot side of a single-stage TEC. A microbolometer needs no cryocooling — only stabilization: the FPA is pinned at 288 K ±10 mK so the resistance operating point cannot drift. This is exactly why it was chosen over an MCT photon detector: MCT demands 77 K from a Stirling cryocooler — a moving part — and nothing on this tower is allowed to wear out.

specs.MCT 对比: 77 K 斯特林 ~17 W 输入

sim: TEC vs MCT 账(mars-ir/out/04):卡诺 COP 0.36 × 斯特林实际 5% → 抽 0.3 W 需 ~17 W;单级 TEC 抽 263 mW 负载仅 ~0.33 W → 51:1
代价账:微测辐射热计放弃光子极限 D* 与微秒响应,换全固态零维护——监控站的正确取舍
sim_en: TEC vs MCT ledger (mars-ir/out/04): Carnot COP 0.36 × 5 % Stirling reality → ~17 W for 0.3 W lift; one-stage TEC moves the 263 mW load for ~0.33 W → 51:1
The price: a microbolometer gives up photon-limited D* and microsecond response for solid-state zero maintenance — the right trade for a monitoring station
physics: 光子探测器必须冻住热激发暗电流(带隙小 → 77 K);热探测器反过来把'变热'当信号,室温即工作——这是 8–14 µm 探测器谱系的根本分岔
剖切侧可见完整热路:VOx die(墨蓝)→ TEC 白瓷 → 铜热管 → 尾鳍,热走到哪几何跟到哪
physics_en: A photon detector must freeze out thermally excited dark current (small bandgap → 77 K); a thermal detector instead uses 'getting warm' as its signal and works at room temperature — the fundamental fork in the 8–14 µm detector family tree
The cutaway shows the full heat path: VOx die (ink blue) → white TEC ceramic → copper heat pipe → rear fins; the geometry follows the heat

pois.label: 云台扫视机构
pois.detail: 两轴云台:方位 ±60° 一分钟一个来回,俯仰在 -15°..-3° 之间缓慢点头,基准姿态俯视城区。凝视型阵列本可以不动——让它扫起来有两个理由:一是 31° 视场靠扫描拼出全城覆盖,二是无快门校准需要的'场景多样性'由云台白送(见设备柜卡)。
pois.detail_en: Two-axis gimbal: azimuth sweeps ±60° once a minute, elevation nods slowly between -15° and -3°, resting pose looking down at the city. A staring array could sit still — it scans for two reasons: the 31° FOV tiles into full city coverage, and the scene diversity that shutterless calibration needs comes free with the pan (see cabinet card).

specs.全覆盖: 方位一循环 ≈ 150° 楔形走廊

sim: 分辨账(mars-ir/out/02):IFOV 0.857 mrad → 100 m 8.6 cm、400 m 34 cm——管廊断热点(分米级)在 400 m 内可分辨
扫描即标定:每帧视场平移 ~2°,相邻帧同一地物落在不同像元上——场景 NUC 的收敛条件由机构免费满足
sim_en: Resolution ledger (mars-ir/out/02): IFOV 0.857 mrad → 8.6 cm at 100 m, 34 cm at 400 m — decimeter-scale pipe-rack cold bridges resolvable within 400 m
Scanning is calibration: each frame shifts the view ~2°, so the same ground patch lands on different pixels — the convergence condition for scene-based NUC is met for free by the mechanism
physics: 微测辐射热计 τ=7.7 ms 定了扫速上限:视轴角速度 6°/s 时单帧拖影 ≈ 0.05°≪IFOV 拼接格,慢扫是灵敏度换来的纪律
physics_en: The 7.7 ms pixel τ caps the scan rate: at 6°/s the per-frame smear is ≈0.05°, far below the mosaic grid — slow scanning is the discipline sensitivity demands

pois.label: 伪彩热图屏(在看的热像仪)
pois.label_en: False-Color Thermal Display (a camera that really sees)
pois.detail: 操作台屏幕不是贴图——机头锗镜后挂着一台真的感知相机(引擎 §4c 传感器通道,64×64@2 Hz),它看到的城市画面逐帧映射成 ironbow 伪彩显示在这里:云台转到哪,屏上画面跟到哪。天空恒冷(8–14 µm 火星天空亮温远低于地表),地表暖,发光的舱体窗与散热阵在夜里是亮斑。显示层用亮度作温度代理并按行压低天空,非辐射定标——卡上的数字才是定标账。
pois.detail_en: This screen is not a texture — a real perception camera hangs behind the Ge lens (engine §4c sensor channel, 64×64 @ 2 Hz), and what it sees is mapped frame by frame into ironbow false color here: wherever the gimbal points, the picture follows. The sky stays cold (Mars sky brightness temperature in 8–14 µm is far below the ground), terrain reads warm, and lit habitat windows and the radiator field glow at night. The display uses luminance as a temperature proxy with a sky-row prior — not radiometric; the numbers on these cards are the calibrated ledger.

specs.伪彩: ironbow 6 段查找 + 自动量程 EMA
specs.降级: 无通道时退回纯 t 程序化热场

specs_en.Fallback: procedural pure-t thermal field without the channel

sim: 场景辐射账(mars-ir/out/03):dM/dT 从 2.39 (290 K) 掉到 0.36 W/m²K (180 K),等效 NETD 52→343 mK——最冷冬夜土壤 1 K 温差仍 >5σ 可辨
昼夜对比度反转(半无限土柱 FD,Jezero 18.4°N):基岩−尘土 = 正午 -27 K / 凌晨4时 +40 K,过零在傍晚 ~16 h 与清晨 ~7 h
城内实测:引擎回填 20 帧/10 s 泵动,屏上冷天空-暖地平线-城内热斑逐帧刷新
sim_en: Scene radiance ledger (mars-ir/out/03): dM/dT falls from 2.39 (290 K) to 0.36 W/m²K (180 K), effective NETD 52→343 mK — a 1 K soil contrast stays >5σ on the coldest winter night
Day/night contrast reversal (semi-infinite soil FD, Jezero 18.4°N): bedrock−dust = -27 K at noon / +40 K at 4 am, zero crossings near 16 h and 7 h
In-city measurement: engine returned 20 frames per 10 s pump; the screen refreshes cold sky, warm horizon and city hot spots frame by frame
physics: 白天图像 = 温度+反照率的混合(晒热的低热惯性尘土最亮);夜里只剩热惯性——覆土层漏热、管廊断热点要在夜图里找,这就是对比度反转的用法
8–14 µm 恰好骑在 300 K 普朗克峰(9.7 µm)上,带内占全谱 37%——这扇大气窗口是被黑体物理选中的
physics_en: A daytime image mixes temperature with albedo (sun-heated low-inertia dust reads hottest); at night only thermal inertia remains — buried-hab heat leaks and pipe-rack cold bridges are hunted in night frames; that is how you use the contrast reversal
8–14 µm rides the 300 K Planck peak (9.7 µm) with 37 % of total emission in band — this atmospheric window was chosen by blackbody physics

pois.label: 设备柜与无快门校准
pois.detail: 柜里是电源、数传和校准的秘密:这台热像仪没有快门。像元电压对 FPA 自身温度的敏感度是对场景的 258 倍——FPA 漂 10 mK 等于场景 2.6 K 假信号,这就是地球上热像仪都装快门的原因。这里靠三件事代替:TEC 把 FPA 钉在 ±10 mK、片上盲元行做共模抑制、云台扫描的场景多样性喂连续 NUC。快门会是全站第一个被尘和低温杀死的运动件——省掉它是火星工程,不是省钱。
pois.detail_en: Inside: power, telemetry, and the calibration secret — this camera has no shutter. Pixel voltage is 258× more sensitive to the FPA's own temperature than to the scene; a 10 mK FPA drift equals a 2.6 K scene artifact, which is why Earth thermal cameras carry shutters. Three things replace it here: the TEC pins the FPA to ±10 mK, on-chip blind rows reject common mode, and the pan's scene diversity feeds continuous NUC. A shutter would be the first moving part dust and cold kill on this tower — deleting it is Mars engineering, not cost cutting.

specs.残差预算: 盲元后 52 + 场景 NUC 20 → ~55 mK
specs.代价: 出厂 -40..+30 ℃ 多温标定档案

specs_en.Residual budget: 52 after blind rows + 20 scene NUC → ~55 mK

sim: 选型账(mars-ir/out/05):机械快门=运动件+致盲 0.3 s;斩波轮=凝视阵列不需要的 50% 占空;无快门残差 ~55 mK 预算闭合
绝对定标:每 ~100 sol 用夜间天空 + 城内恒温散热阵两点重标(尘漂移账 out/04)
sim_en: Selection ledger (mars-ir/out/05): mechanical shutter = moving part + 0.3 s blindness; chopper = 50 % duty a staring array never needed; shutterless residual ~55 mK, budget closed
Absolute calibration: two-point re-cal every ~100 sol against night sky + the city's isothermal radiator field (dust drift ledger out/04)
physics: 快门的本质是'人造均匀场景'——把每个像元的偏移一次清零;没有快门,就必须让偏移不漂(TEC+盲元)或让场景自己当快门(扫描 NUC)
固定凝视相机才是无快门的难场景;本站云台使 SBNUC 的数学条件(同一地物历经多像元)恒成立
physics_en: A shutter is an artificial uniform scene — zeroing every pixel's offset at once; without one you must stop the offset from drifting (TEC + blind rows) or let the scene be the shutter (scan-based NUC)
A static staring camera is the hard case for shutterless; this station's pan keeps the SBNUC condition — one ground patch crossing many pixels — permanently true

pois.label: 站址与探测器谱系
pois.detail: 5.2 m 格构塔把视轴抬离近地尘幕,立在城东北高地环境预警组团——与气象站(尘暴 τ)、辐射站(SEP 警报)背靠背:气象站说'尘来了',辐射站说'粒子来了',热像仪说'哪里在漏热'。这是全城探测器谱系里 8–14 µm 中远红外的第一双眼睛:此前城里有可见光、近红外 LiDAR、粒子、X/γ——就是没有一台能看见热。
pois.detail_en: The 5.2 m lattice tower lifts the sightline above the near-ground dust veil, standing on the northeast highland in the environmental-warning cluster — back to back with the weather station (dust τ) and the radiation station (SEP alerts): weather says 'dust is coming', radiation says 'particles are coming', and the thermal imager says 'here is where the heat leaks'. It is the city's first pair of eyes in the 8–14 µm mid/far-IR: the city had visible, NIR lidar, particle and X/γ detectors — but nothing that could see heat.

specs.塔高: 5.2 m 格构 + 云台 (总高 6.8 m)
specs.监控清单: 覆土热惯性/管廊传热/散热阵/舱体漏热

specs_en.Watch list: regolith thermal inertia / pipe-rack transfer / radiator field / habitat shell leaks

sim: 选址烟测:候选 (318,-262) audit clean,距辐射站 14 m/气象站 42 m;备选:俯瞰全城的更高点由总控定夺
整循环包络扫描:云台全程 maxY 6.80/minY 0,极限位与护栏无干涉
sim_en: Siting smoke test: candidate (318,-262) audit clean, 14 m from the radiation station, 42 m from weather; alternative: a higher city-overlook point at the coordinator's discretion
Full-cycle envelope scan: maxY 6.80 / minY 0 throughout the gimbal cycle, no railing interference at extremes
physics: 看热的相机必须自己不热得乱七八糟:保温壳+遮阳盖+尾鳍朝北,让镜筒温漂困在 ±11 K 免调焦窗口内(锗 dn/dT 账)
physics_en: A camera that watches heat must not run hot itself: insulated housing, sun roof and north-facing fins keep barrel drift inside the ±11 K no-refocus window (the Ge dn/dT ledger)
